item.title: refactor(voice): promote realtime voice policy to talk owner (#122668)
item.summary: refactor(voice): promote realtime voice policy to talk owner (#122668) * refactor(voice): promote realtime voice policy to talk owner Move the exact-speech protocol (typed consult-call outcome instead of string scraping), agent-proxy session instructions, and consult/wake-name/ barge-in policy defaults from the Discord plugin into src/talk, exported additively via openclaw/plugin-sdk/realtime-voice. Wake-name enablement now keys on a supportsActivationNameGating provider capability instead of a hardcoded provider id. Follow-up to the voice split (#122479). * fix(talk): bind exact-speech bypass to retained session state Per ClawSweeper review on #122668: the protocol marker is untrusted model tool-call text; only a parsed answer matching a currently retained exact-speech text may select the privileged replay path. Unretained marker calls route to a normal consult.
